documents.content: Original query: Seeking electrical labourer work despite ECS card and 1 year experience. Provided extensive CV showing PhD, teaching background, director experience, and diverse technical projects.

ESP Organizer project description revealed: Production-ready Dockerized RAG system with Hierarchical Semantic Graph architecture using Go, React, Weaviate, AWS Bedrock/Titan. 3-stage semantic processing pipeline with relativistic hierarchy. System 55% complete but core RAG functionality broken.

Toby Fotherby (AWS Senior AI/ML Specialist) endorsement: 'One of the most thoughtful and capable practitioners... mastery of AI architecture fundamentals... confident he will make significant impact in any AI initiative.'

Diagnosis: Visionary architect trapped in execution gap. Pattern of starting complex systems (cancer therapy 1994, CO2 sequestration 2001, Skills Map 2018) but struggling to complete due to scope creep, financial pressure, and context switching.

Critical personal context: Partner studying for immunology consultant exam (second attempt), father with dementia, one daughter in civil engineering degree, another in GCSEs. Financial pressure with job ending soon. Working 4 jobs until 11:30 PM daily.

ESP Organizer technical status: Infrastructure 95% complete (Docker, AWS, databases) but semantic link extraction broken and HSG query system incomplete. Adobe PDF Spaces identified as immediate solution for partner's immunology studies.

Strategic pivot recommended: Use Adobe PDF Spaces for immediate family needs. Treat HSG as portfolio piece for AI Solutions Architect roles. Focus on completing ONE demonstrable feature rather than entire system.

GCSE progress tracking identified as valuable short-term feature: Color-coded heat map of topics with score history. Technically simpler than HSG but provides immediate utility for daughter's studies.
Voice interface strategy: Browser-based Web Speech API for quick implementation, with Adobe API LLM as query refinement bridge. Enables hands-free studying for partner.

LinkedIn strategy: Do NOT pivot to AI Solutions Architect until portfolio piece is complete. Current positioning should be 'Go/React Developer | AWS | Full-Stack' for contract work to generate immediate income.
Adobe API bridge strategy: Use manual semantic links as gold-standard dataset to train Adobe LLM for consistent relationship extraction. Creates professional data pipeline rather than quick hack.

F1 car vs bicycle analogy: HSG is over-engineered for GCSE content (bicycle needed) but perfectly suited for complex immunology reasoning (F1 territory). Stop using wrong problems to test advanced architecture.
Lecture transcription solutions: Otter.ai recommended for partner's immunology lectures. Custom vocabulary feature can handle medical terminology. $16.99/month justified by time savings.

Friend's characterization as 'puppy always looking for new trick' identified as core problem. Diagnosis: Intellectual ADHD - addicted to novelty, allergic to completion. Recommended behavioral modification strategies.

Current crisis: Job ending in one week, two weeks holiday pay remaining. Partner under extreme pressure with exam and family health issues. Immediate focus must be on financial stabilization, not technical projects.

HSG as AISA portfolio piece: Complete system demonstrates full AI stack mastery (vector DBs, LLM orchestration, embeddings, cloud infrastructure). Unique value in relativistic hierarchy and multi-hop reasoning.

Core execution gap identified: Trying to be visionary, architect, and builder simultaneously. Need to partner with 'finisher' or develop ruthless prioritization. 80% infrastructure complete but last 20% of business logic blocking value delivery.

Emotional context: Fear of being burden, £150k financial loss, 13 unsuccessful interviews creating trauma response. Current work pattern (4 jobs until 11:30 PM) is survival mode, not sustainable creative work.

Applied for Bookings Coordinator role at Artrix theatre. CV rewritten to emphasize coordination, logistics, and administrative skills from David Manners experience. Example of practical job search strategy during crisis.

Current query: Want to ingest entire conversation history into vector database for future reference and to prevent knowledge loss. This represents using own architecture to solve immediate organizational problem.

recommended_queries: What is the current crisis status and immediate next actions?
What technical blocks need to be solved for HSG completion?
What career strategy should I follow given current constraints?
What family support systems can I implement quickly?
How do I balance immediate income with long-term goals?
What patterns of behavior are holding me back?
What is the simplest version of HSG that provides portfolio value?
How can I use my own tools to solve my organizational problems?
